privacy.hero.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: pyBIM is committed to protecting your privacy and personal data in strict compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR - Regulation EU 2016/679) and applicable data protection legislation. This Privacy Policy informs you how we process personal data collected through our public website, inquiry forms, and ROI calculator.

privacy.sec1.title: 1. Data Controller
privacy.sec1.desc: The Data Controller responsible for your personal data is pyBIM:
privacy.sec2.title: 2. Types of Data Collected
privacy.sec2.desc: We collect and process the following categories of personal data:
privacy.sec2.item1.title: Data Provided Voluntarily by the User:
privacy.sec2.item1.desc: Name, email address, corporate role, project details, and any architectural specifications provided through our Contact, Early Access, or ROI Matrix forms.
privacy.sec2.item2.title: Technical and Security Browsing Data:
privacy.sec2.item2.desc: IP address (anonymized/truncated for analytics), device and browser user-agent, timestamp, and Cloudflare Turnstile bot verification tokens required to safeguard web services.
privacy.sec3.title: 3. Purposes of Processing
privacy.sec3.desc: Personal data is processed exclusively for specified, explicit, and legitimate purposes:
privacy.sec3.item1: Responding to technical inquiries, project evaluations, and quotation requests.
privacy.sec3.item2: Delivering ROI calculation reports and Early Access application updates requested by the user.
privacy.sec3.item3: Ensuring website resilience, infrastructure integrity, and preventing automated abuse (Cloudflare Turnstile).
privacy.sec3.item4: Complying with statutory, tax, and accounting requirements for bilateral B2B contracts.
privacy.sec4.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
privacy.sec4.desc: Data processing is carried out pursuant to Article 6(1) of the GDPR:
privacy.sec4.item1: Performance of pre-contractual steps taken at the request of the data subject (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacy.sec4.item2: Legitimate interest in securing web infrastructure against bot spam and unauthorized access (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
privacy.sec4.item3: Compliance with legal obligations under applicable law (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).
privacy.sec5.title: 5. Data Retention Periods
privacy.sec5.desc: We retain personal data only for as long as strictly necessary to fulfill the purpose for which it was gathered:
privacy.sec5.item1: Technical inquiries and ROI calculation records: retained for up to 12 months, then securely expunged unless followed by a formal commercial contract.
privacy.sec5.item2: B2B client contract and accounting documentation: retained for 10 years in compliance with statutory fiscal requirements.
privacy.sec5.item3: Sovereign AI client project execution data: governed by bilateral NDA and destroyed from RAM/ephemeral storage immediately upon script handover.
privacy.sec6.title: 6. Third-Party Service Providers and Data Transfers
privacy.sec6.desc: We never sell, rent, or trade your personal data. Data is shared strictly with essential operational service providers bound by Data Processing Agreements (DPAs):
privacy.sec6.item1: Cloudflare, Inc. — Global edge hosting, DDoS mitigation, and Turnstile privacy-preserving bot detection.
privacy.sec6.item2: Resend, Inc. — Transactional email dispatch for inbound contact confirmations and ROI report delivery.
privacy.sec6.item3: Iubenda — External legal policy hosting and compliance documentation.
privacy.sec7.title: 7. Security Measures and Technical Safeguards
privacy.sec7.desc: We implement state-of-the-art technical and organizational measures to safeguard data against accidental loss, unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. All web transit is encrypted via TLS 1.3, API payloads are validated against strict JSON schemas, and customer BIM engineering assets are handled under air-gapped, zero-telemetry protocols.
privacy.sec8.title: 8. Your Rights Under GDPR
privacy.sec8.desc: Under Articles 15 to 22 of the GDPR, you have the right to:
privacy.sec8.item1: Request access to your personal data held by pyBIM.
privacy.sec8.item2: Request rectification of inaccurate or incomplete personal information.
privacy.sec8.item3: Request erasure of your data ('Right to be Forgotten') where statutory retention does not apply.
privacy.sec8.item4: Request restriction of processing or object to processing on legitimate grounds.
privacy.sec8.contact: To exercise any of these rights, contact our privacy desk directly at: info@pybim.com.
